command:
uv run iris --config lib/iris/config/marin.yaml job run --no-wait \
  --enable-extra-resources --cpu 2 --memory 8GB --disk 32GB --timeout 172800 \
  --max-retries 0 --max-preemption-retries 0 \
  --extra cpu --no-preemptible --region us-central1 --zone us-central1-a \
  --priority interactive --job-name starcoder-tpp10-refinement-batch-recovery \
  --bundle-include .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/releases/refinement.json \
  --exclude '^(checkpoints|logs|wandb)/' \
  --exclude '^experiments/domain_phase_mix/exploratory/.*(?<!\.py)$' \
  --exclude '^\.agents/(?!projects/starcoder_tpp10/releases/).*' \
  --exclude '^(docs|tests)/' \
  --exclude '^lib/[^/]+/tests/' \
  --exclude '^experiments/domain_phase_mix/exploratory/two_phase_many/reference_outputs/' \
  -e MARIN_PREFIX gs://marin-us-central1 \
  -e WANDB_API_KEY "$WANDB_API_KEY" \
  -- python -m experiments.domain_phase_mix.resume_starcoder_tpp10_refinement_batch --release .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/releases/refinement.json \
  --plan-path .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/live/refinement_plan.json --max-concurrent 45 --submit
name: starcoder-tpp10-refinement-batch-recovery

body: Refinement recovery has dispatched exactly the 34 unfinished recipes. All 34 actual controller requests have BATCH priority, central1-a placement and the approved recovery bundle. Their serialized callable hashes match the original training jobs, and the mapped run-name set equals exactly the unfinished plan rows. All 11 completed recipes were omitted and their successful artifact fingerprints were reverified. The 34 children await TPU capacity; executor RUNNING states reflect held leases, not active training. Recorded each new job as a retry of its original child and linked it to the existing Fieldbook run. FineMath parent preparation independently passes token count (190,316,544), recipe/source identity, tokenizer, fingerprint and frozen permutation checks; its matched subset is queued for CPU capacity. No new-domain training has started. No manual resubmission or cluster/scientific change was made.
title: All 34 refinement children verified batch; FineMath parent complete
